visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straight brown hair and heavy eye makeup is seen in a medium close-up, wearing a pink dress. She is carefully applying black eyeliner to her right eyelid with a pen. In the background, a young man with dark hair, wearing a denim jacket and a silver necklace, is standing and looking at his phone while holding a small, dark brown poodle in his left arm. The background includes a modern kitchen area with a stainless steel refrigerator and bright ceiling lights. (2) The man in the background looks up from his phone, checks his watch, and points to it emphatically with his right hand, looking at the woman with a frustrated expression. He then gestures toward the side as if to say they are late. The woman glances at him with a slight smirk but continues her makeup application. (3) The man goes back to looking at his phone with a resigned look. The woman switches to a makeup brush and begins applying a pink blush to her right cheek, looking directly into the camera lens with a satisfied and playful smile as she completes her look.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To create a relatable and humorous short-form video about the gendered stereotype of a woman taking a long time to get ready while her boyfriend waits impatiently. The humor is derived from the contrast between her calm, detailed makeup application and his increasing restlessness in the background.
